name: TommyLeePeeca
headline: Quotes both sides of live CS2 (and some Dota 2) match markets and collects the spread plus Obsidian-tier taker rebates. A maker without its live game data loses 8-9% of capital deployed in the same matches at every delay tested, and below the top rebate tier its month falls to about $33k.
mechanism: 87% of sampled fills are maker fills (on-chain, 95% CI 82-91%); 99% occur after match start; 98% of volume is CS2. It buys both outcomes in 92% of markets at a median pair cost of 1.00 (balance 0.84). Locked pair spread is -$50k over 30 days and the residual +$137k, so profit comes from leaning quotes toward the side that wins rounds, which needs live round-level information.

roc.detail: peak capital at risk $9.6k; 30-day PnL $60.3k; 629% per month

match.detail: no public timestamped CS2 round feed exists to reconstruct its quote decisions; tape-only rule does not reproduce its fills

backtest.detail: public-data two-sided maker on 80 held-out matches: -8.3% (0 s) to -9.3% (30 s), all significant losses; wallet's own passive fills there +1.9% (p=0.056)

replicable.detail: needs low-latency live game data to avoid adverse selection; at a 0% taker rebate tier its 30-day PnL would be ~$33k (< $50k)

reasons: A public-data maker loses significantly in the same CS2 markets at every delay tested.
Its edge depends on live round-level information that has no free public feed.
It relies on the 50% Obsidian taker rebate to clear $50k per month.
